Aggregate CTAS site scores into the gsm Analysis_Analyzed contract

Summarize_CTAS.Rd

CTAS returns one score per (timeseries x feature x group), while gsm expects one row per group per metric. Summarize_CTAS() filters the shared Analyze_CTAS() output to a single feature and collapses it over timeseries.

Usage

Summarize_CTAS(
  dfSiteScores,
  strFeature,
  strGroupLevel = "Site",
  vGroupIDs = NULL,
  dHigh = 2.326,
  dLow = 0.842
)

Arguments

dfSiteScores

data.frame The site_scores element of Analyze_CTAS().

strFeature

character Single CTAS feature to summarise, e.g. "average".

strGroupLevel

character gsm group level, "Site" or "Country".

vGroupIDs

character Optional complete vector of group IDs.

dHigh

numeric Score at or above which a timeseries triggers "Further Evaluation".

dLow

numeric Score at or above which a timeseries is put on the "Watch List".

Value

data.frame with GroupID, GroupLevel, Numerator, Denominator, Metric and Score.

Details

Groups with no evaluated timeseries for the feature are retained with Denominator = 0, Metric = NA and Score = NA, so that the report does not silently drop them. Supply vGroupIDs to complete the grid against a known group list; otherwise only groups present in dfSiteScores appear.

The default thresholds 2.326 / 0.842 are drawn from experience rather than derived. They are one-sided normal z-quantiles (99% / 80%) applied to a -log10(p) scale, where they correspond to p = 0.0047 and p = 0.144. Override them from the workflow YAML meta block where a different convention is wanted.

Examples

dfSiteScores <- data.frame(
  timeseries_id = c("ts1", "ts2", "ts1"),
  site = c("001", "001", "002"),
  country = "USA",
  feature = "average",
  fdr_corrected_pvalue_logp = c(3.1, 0.5, 1.0)
)
Summarize_CTAS(dfSiteScores, strFeature = "average")
#> # A tibble: 2 × 6
#>   GroupID GroupLevel Numerator Denominator Metric Score
#>   <chr>   <chr>          <dbl>       <dbl>  <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1 001     Site               1           2    0.5   3.1
#> 2 002     Site               0           1    0     1
